verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a conversational AI assistant that chases missing receipts, explains card declines, or answers pre-spend 'can I expense this?' questions. The marketing line about 'AI-powered spend management' that is 'automatically compliant' does not describe a conversational policy-enforcement experience. The Invoice Coding Agent is an AP bill-coding feature, and the MCP server only exposes developer documentation, so neither counts for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI assistant enforces policy conversationally — chasing missing receipts, explaining declines, and answering "can I expense this?" before the spend happens
